about.shortBio:
Hey, I am Alex. I'm a Computer Science student currently based in Munich, Germany. I'm passionate about creating, building, and combining ideas and interests. I like to think creatively and find non-trivial solutions to my problems :) 
 These days, I primarily like to work on web apps or new machine learning technologies, mainly using PyTorch or Next.js. It's interesting how many things there are out there!
